audit.why: TRICKY 7.5/10 against a 50.31% record is defensible: Poppy owns levels 2-3, the middle is even, and Rumble reclaims it on items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Rumble, Rumble, Skill, Skill, Rumble, Rumble in both layers; the packet has Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Skill, Skill, Skill, Rumble.
audit.why: whys[1] and whys[2] both describe levels 2-3 as your strongest early window with a free wall-stun on a dashless target, printed on Rumble rows; whys[5] calls first item 'even, not won' on a Rumble row.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 flipped as one atomic paired group in both layers to Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Skill, Skill, Skill, Rumble. Row 1 and 2 ratings to 6/10, row 6 to 3/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early block attributes Iron Ambassador to Rumble — 'His Iron Ambassador buckler matters: if you can break the shield before trading' — but Iron Ambassador is Poppy's own passive. His shield is Scrap Shield (W) on a flat 6s cooldown. The trading rules also promise to W his dash; Rumble's kit has no dash.
audit.why: The advice reads as 'break his buckler', which does not exist, and it hides the real problem: Scrap Shield comes back every 6 seconds, so it cannot be baited out the way the cooldown block claims.
audit.corrected: Buckler restored to Poppy, Scrap Shield named with its 6s cooldown, and the dash-denial replaced with the actual read — he is dashless, so the wall-stun is unconditional if you reach him.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to build MR without mentioning that Electro Harpoon reduces magic resist, and stacks twice.
audit.why: It directly undercuts the core item advice — his poke shreds the stat you bought, so the MR has to come with the resist scaling on W's passive rather than alone.
audit.corrected: Added to the mid block alongside the heat read.

edits.before: Rumble is squishy and has no dash, so levels 2-3 are your window — bait him to commit Flamespitter near a wall, then E him into it for the stun and chunk his max HP with Q. His Iron Ambassador buckler matters: if you can break the shield before trading, his sustain drops off hard. Watch his heat bar — don't walk into a freshly overheated Flamespitter, and respect that his E-harpoon slow can peel your engage if you go in greedy without a wall behind him.
edits.after: Rumble is squishy and has no dash, so levels 2-3 are your window — bait him to commit Flamespitter near a wall, then E him into it for the stun and chunk his max HP with Q. Your own Iron Ambassador buckler matters: pick it back up before you trade, because his burn is sustained rather than burst. Scrap Shield returns every 6s, so you cannot bait it out — read the heat bar instead, and respect that Electro Harpoon's slow peels a greedy engage with no wall behind him.

edits.before: This is the even stretch. Your flat damage doesn't climb with ability points the way his Flamespitter scaling does, so you lean on the wall-stun and percent-HP Q rather than raw kill threat. At 6 your R isn't a burst spike — it's a peel/disengage tool, but it's a great answer to his Equalizer: knock him out of his own burn zone or carry him away from his all-in. Keep stacking MR early so his overheated bar stops melting you, and never trade standing in his ult.
edits.after: This is the even stretch. Your damage doesn't climb the way his Flamespitter scaling does, so lean on the wall-stun and max-HP Q rather than kill threat. At 6 your R is peel, not burst, but it answers The Equalizer cleanly: punt him out of his own burn zone. Buy MR knowing Electro Harpoon shreds it and stacks twice, so pair it with W's low-health resist scaling rather than relying on the stat alone, and never trade standing in his ult.

notes: Corrected a genuine attribution error the packet flagged: the early block said 'His Iron Ambassador buckler' — Iron Ambassador is Poppy's own passive, not Rumble's, and the advice to 'break the shield before trading' pointed at the wrong champion entirely. His shield is Scrap Shield on a flat 6s cooldown, which also means the page's core instruction to bait it out is unworkable; retargeted to the heat bar. Added the item interaction that undercuts the page's own build advice: Electro Harpoon reduces magic resist and carries two charges. Rumble has no dash, so the 'W any dash he tries' line is dead here too — fixed in tradeGood and dosFull[1], still present verbatim in breakdown.trading and report[3].t.
